EFFICIENT AND 
COMPATIBLE 
LAND USE 
The City’s limited land resources will be organized 
and regulated to encourage efficient, compatible, 
and synergetic land uses that provide for housing, 
commerce, employment, education, recreation, and 
other human needs. Land use policies and standards 
will limit urban sprawl, protect natural resources and 
farmland, foster complete neighborhoods, promote 
social interaction and community-building, and 
enhance walkability and transit access.
